result.question: What was Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024?
result.answer: Apple's total net sales in fiscal year 2024 (the 52-week fiscal year ended September 28, 2024) were $391,035 million, or approximately $391.0 billion [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. This total comprised $294,866 million in Products net sales and $96,169 million in Services net sales [0000320193-24-000123:item-8-p001]. This represented an increase of about 2% from fiscal 2023 total net sales of $383,285 million [0000320193-24-000123:item-7-p001]. The same $391,035 million figure is confirmed in Apple's Q4 2024 press release (8-K) and in the XBRL facts of the subsequent 10-K filing [0000320193-24-000120:ex-99-press-release-p002] [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2024-09-28].
